description: This source file defines Express.js route handlers for managing insurance claims. It includes Swagger documentation annotations for API specifications, and routes for listing, creating, retrieving, updating, patching, and deleting claims, linking to claimsController for business logic.

methods.name: router.get('/')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to list claims with optional filtering parameters.

methods.name: router.post('/')
methods.description: Handles POST requests to create a new claim.

methods.name: router.get('/:claimId')
methods.description: Handles GET requests to retrieve a claim by its ID.

methods.name: router.put('/:claimId')
methods.description: Handles PUT requests to replace an existing claim.

methods.name: router.patch('/:claimId')
methods.description: Handles PATCH requests to update certain fields of a claim.

methods.name: router.delete('/:claimId')
methods.description: Handles DELETE requests to delete a claim by ID.
